versions.changelog:
- Initial release of stakeholder-comms skill.
- Provides a deep workflow for effective stakeholder communication, from audience mapping to follow-ups.
- Includes structured guidance for exec updates, cross-team notes, and managing expectations under uncertainty.
- Features a five-stage process: audience & outcome, facts & narrative, risks & trade-offs, ask & decision, cadence & follow-up.
- Offers practical tips, review checklist, and advice for handling political and cultural nuances.
